summary: Complete frontend testing of Xbox 360 Dashboard replica (Vortex-Prime-EMU) iteration 12. All 20 new features verified successfully. Open WebUI button with SVG icon replaces old AI button and opens AI panel. Guide overlay correctly opens to Friends and Parties tab by default. Friends section shows Xbox Live (6 friends) and Discord (5 friends) platforms. Parties section allows creating solo party with 'You' as Party Leader, Invite More shows 7 available friends with Invite/Invited states. Messages tab shows 5 conversations with unread badges and platform tags (XBL/DC), clicking opens detail with functional Invite to Party button and Coming Soon Invite to Game button. Home tab shows 5 recently played games with Quick Resume badges on first 3. Footer hint correctly switches between 'Close' and 'Back' based on navigation depth.

issues: Some game cover images fail to load (Wikipedia URLs returning broken images) - affects Spider-Man, Bionic Commando, Halo 3, Gears of War 2 covers. Red Dead Redemption cover loads correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Guide Overlay has 3 tabs (Friends and Parties, Messages, Home). Open WebUI button in header opens AI panel. Friends section has hierarchical navigation: main -> Friends/Parties -> Xbox Live/Discord -> friend list. Parties supports Create Party -> active party with Invite More. Messages shows 5 conversations with detail view containing Invite to Party (functional) and Invite to Game (Coming Soon). Mock data includes 6 Xbox friends, 5 Discord friends, and 5 conversations in xeniaData.js. All features use mock data - no backend APIs required.

mocked_apis.note: All backend APIs are mocked. Friends, Discord friends, and conversations use mock data from xeniaData.js.
